payload.title: P4-14: port video-script loading in the GraphQL content repository (article/edition video scripts)
payload.description: P4-03 (Papyrus#150) moved the blog layout components and added the optional videoScripts field on EditionContent, passed through the rhythm renderers, but the fork video-script loading in the GraphQL content repository (how Threat Intelligence loads edition/article video scripts from the backend) is NOT ported. Threat Intelligence uses edition/article videos (baseline has a PLAY VIDEO button and edition video blocks). Port the loader generically (any brand with videoPlayer set), with tests against the content model, so a publication on the packages shows the same videos as the fork. Check what data the old backend holds (baseline: /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/threat-intelligence-20261007/) and that the P4-08/P4-09 copy tool carries the video-script fields. Also carry the figure.article-video margin-bottom 2em rule in the TI theme (P4-04).
